PRISM THIRD-PARTY SOFTWARE NOTICES
================================

Prism uses Qt under the GNU Lesser General Public License version 3. Included
GLib, libintl and libiconv libraries use the LGPL terms identified in their
package folders. Full license texts and copyright notices are included in
THIRD-PARTY. Corresponding source copies are in THIRD-PARTY/SOURCES, including
the build recipes and modifications for the reviewed Windows packages.
LIBRARY-REPLACEMENT.txt explains how to rebuild and replace these libraries.

You may modify and replace the LGPL libraries and reverse engineer the
application as necessary to debug those modifications. No application terms
restrict these library rights. There is no runtime integrity lock preventing
replacement of the included library files.

Portions of this software are copyright © 1996-2026 The FreeType Project
(https://freetype.org). All rights reserved. FreeType is used under the FTL
option; the complete notice and license are retained in its package folder.

The included libjpeg API library is based in part on the work of the Independent
JPEG Group. Its IJG, BSD and zlib notices are retained in the libjpeg-turbo folder.

The included GCC runtime libraries are used under GPLv3 with the GCC Runtime
Library Exception 3.1 for eligible compilation of this independent application.
The full exception and license texts are retained in the gcc-libs folder.

The reviewed libgraphite2 and libzstd runtime components use their available MIT
and BSD license alternatives respectively. liblcms2 uses MIT; liblzma uses 0BSD.
All applicable copyright/license texts are retained; see distribution-review.json
and dependency-inventory.json for the exact reviewed component versions and files.

TIFF support is retained through libtiff 4.7.2 under its upstream MIT-style
license, with JBIG compression disabled. JBIG-compressed TIFF is unsupported.
No JBIG-KIT runtime is bundled. Source, recipe and license are in tiff-runtime/.
